notes: RTM image; median of three calls after one warm-up; fixed seed 170101. Metal timing includes harness file I/O and process startup. Memory is the maximum of three peaks; memory methods differ and do not measure the same allocations. MLX process RSS is a lifetime high-water mark; Metal RSS includes shared buffers only as reflected in OS process accounting. Relative difference is max absolute error divided by max absolute reference image.
